## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/7997-detail-view-related-retired.md`

- names `RecordDetailView.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **Why it retired.** `@objectstack/spec` declares no `DetailView` schema at all — every `DetailView` occurrence in `packages/spec/src` is prose about this repo's own `RecordDetailView.tsx` — so this array mirrored no protocol schema and drifted freely: it declared `columns` as `TableColumn[]` while the renderer it fed also accepted bare field names, `{ field, label }` and legacy `{ name, label }` spellings. The axis that carried the ruling was measured **zero pull**: no application code authored the member, both internal producers of a `detail-view` node (`RecordDetailDrawer`, `renderers/record-details.tsx`) synthesize it without `related`, and the only in-tree authorings carrying real columns were two documents — both rewritten here.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `e327c8998` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1715 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2319 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36514424948)

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The reaction write's accept-set (the card's defect) — RIGHT.** `storedReactions` writes each emoji's `userIds` exactly as read. `toggleOwnReaction(reactions, emoji, userId)` adds or filters only `userId` in the clicked emoji, drops an emoji left with no ids, and derives `count` from `userIds.length`. At the head there is no `'__other__'` literal, no `storedReactionShape` and no count-driven rebuild (grepped the head file). Triage's two ⛔ (no padding, no list rebuilt from a count) hold.
2. **Triage's pins — RIGHT**, pinned verbatim as test 1 of `RecordDetailView.reactionKeepIds-11019.test.tsx`: a row seeded `{👍: [u2, u3]}`; `u1` adds ❤️ and the write is `{👍: [u2, u3], ❤️: [u1]}`; `u1` adds 👍 and the write is `{👍: [u2, u3, u1], ❤️: [u1]}`; re-mounted as `u2`, 👍 reads as own and `u2`'s click writes `{👍: [u3, u1], ❤️: [u1]}`, removing `u2` and nothing else. The test drives the real `RecordDetailView` and the real `ReactionPicker` over a fake data source and observes the `sys_comment` `update` payload, which is the channel the card measured.
3. **The read — RIGHT.** `parseReactions` now fills `Reaction.userIds`, a slot `@object-ui/types` (`views.ts`) already declares as optional ("IDs of users who reacted") and that nothing filled before. `count` and `reacted` derive from the same list as at base, so chips and `aria-selected` are unchanged. `ReactionPicker` reads only `emoji`, `count` and `reacted` (verified), so the `userIds` now carried on screen reaches no consumer.
4. **The new `storedUserIds` throw — RIGHT as a guard, and unreachable today.** Every producer of `FeedItem.reactions` that can reach `handleToggleReaction` was enumerated: `parseReactions` and `toggleOwnReaction` both set `userIds`; `handleAddComment`, `handleAddReply` and `plugin-detail`'s `activityRowToFeedItem` set no `reactions`, so an activity row or a fresh comment takes the new-emoji branch (`idx` below 0) and never calls the guard. Noted, not a finding: the throw is synchronous inside a click handler, which React does not route to an error boundary, so a future producer's breach surfaces as an uncaught error and a no-op click rather than an unmount. Loud, as the PR body intends.
5. **The objectui#10899 rollback ledger — RIGHT, contract unchanged.** Each `ReactionStep` still carries the row's whole set, now with the ids inside it, so a rollback restores the ids with the counts. The pending `.changeset/10899-failed-reaction-write-reverts.md` sentence "The stored `{ emoji: userIds[] }` shape is unchanged" stays true: this diff changes the values written into that map, not the map's shape.
6. **Legacy `'__other__'` rows — RIGHT and stated honestly.** Kept verbatim, counted as someone else's reaction, never as the clicker's (test 2). The ids they replaced are not recoverable, and the changeset says so rather than hiding it.
7. **Public surface — nothing moves.** None of `storedUserIds`, `toggleOwnReaction` or `storedReactions` is exported; `app-shell/src/index.ts` exports only `RecordDetailView` from this module; `@object-ui/types` is untouched; no docs, skills or schema file is in the 3-file diff. The `Reaction.userIds` slot's declared meaning is now honoured, not altered.
8. **The residue — RIGHT per triage.** Last-writer-wins between two simultaneous reactors is stated in the code comment, the PR body and the changeset, and direction A (a server-side toggle) stays unfiled, as triage `5878334754` ruled.
9. **Gates — every derived family is answered by the head's check-runs**, all `success`: `Test` (shards 1/8 to 8/8 plus the rollup), `Test (dist pins)`, `Type Check`, `Lint`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Overwrite Report`, `Changeset Claim Re-read`, `Control Byte Scan`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Build & E2E`.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/11019-reaction-keep-ids.md` declares `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`. `@object-ui/app-shell` is a published package (`publishConfig.access: public`, not private, a member of the fixed group) and the only released package the diff touches; the head's `Changeset Declaration` check agrees. **Patch is the right level**: a behaviour fix in a non-exported code path, with no exported symbol, type, schema or documented contract added, removed or changed, and the stored `sys_comment.reactions` shape is the same `{ emoji: userIds[] }` map as before.
- The PR body's `Clause-②: no` line is **RIGHT** and matches the claim's (`5882045528`): a console panel's write keeps stored data it used to overwrite; no published type, schema or documented contract moves.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations (report `5882728399`), each answered:
1. Declared narrowing (the 562-file `views/` farm was not measured locally; narrowed to the 36 importers) — **ANSWERED by the head's check-runs**: `Test (shard 1/8)` through `Test (shard 8/8)`, the `Test` rollup and `Test (dist pins)` are all `success` on this sha. The full farm ran.
2. Batch A measured at `15c3d88` rather than the head — **ANSWERED the same way**: CI measured the head itself.
3. A one-off probe test file was written and deleted — **ANSWERED**: the PR's file list is exactly 3 files, none a probe, and the diff carries nothing else.
4. Commit trailers use the repo's model-free pair — not a contract matter, and commit messages are outside this review's input set. No action.

- **(a)** An activity row's "Add reaction" writes `sys_comment` by a `sys_activity` id — **ESCALATED to the seat** for its own card. Read at the head: `RecordActivityTimeline` renders `ReactionPicker` for every root item with no `item.type` gate, and `handleToggleReaction` writes `sys_comment` for whatever id it is given. This diff neither causes nor worsens it (an activity item carries no `reactions`, so the click takes the same new-emoji branch as at base) and it never reaches the new guard.
- **(b)** objectstack's `sys_comment.reactions` field description reads "JSON array of emoji reaction objects" while the only in-tree producer and reader stores a map — **ESCALATED to the seat**; a spec-text matter on the objectstack side, not this card.
